about: Twelve cubic-bezier curves fitted to 24 moves tracked frame by frame in the Monsters, Inc. and Monsters University title sequences. Each one is cut into drawings on a 41.667 ms (24 fps) grid in motion-tokens.css.

curves.name: press
curves.use: squash into a press: first drawing at t=0, the extreme held 83 ms

curves.name: release
curves.use: spring back after a press or a hold let go

curves.name: snap
curves.use: launch out of a squash, a pop, a cut-in: the whole move is one drawing

curves.name: arrive
curves.use: slide-stop: things rolling, dealt or swung into place and stopping

curves.name: rise
curves.use: the up half of a toss or hop (decelerating to the apex)

curves.name: drop
curves.use: fall, leave, drain, swept off: starts flat, ends at speed (hard stop)

curves.name: glide
curves.use: swings, tumbles and sweeps that start and stop on their own

curves.name: run
curves.use: constant-speed travel: belts, wires, credits running along a path

curves.name: overshoot
curves.use: a character-like arrival that passes its mark by 18 % and comes back (the film: 13 drawings; the UI: 7)

curves.name: overshoot-soft
curves.use: overshoot at 45 % strength: controls stay on model (squash and stretch run small on buttons); derived from the measured overshoot, not a separate measurement

curves.name: settle
curves.use: the strong ease-out back to rest after an overshoot

curves.name: whip
curves.use: drawn art thrown out of frame: the title exit. The only ease-in for art leaving; a control or popup never uses it
